stem:
Holly made a poster using two congruent pentagons and a square.

What is the perimeter of the poster in inches?
instruction: Record your answer and fill in the bubbles on your answer document. Be sure to use the correct place value.
visual_elements: Image of a poster composed of two congruent pentagons and a square arranged in a row.
Two equal slant lengths on right pentagon labeled 22 in. each.
difficulty_rationale: Requires understanding of perimeter as the sum of all side lengths, identifying and adding congruent pentagon and square side lengths together, involving multi-step conceptual reasoning.
